name: RSI and Bollinger Bands
summary: This EA combines RSI and Bollinger Bands indicators to identify overbought and oversold market conditions for mean reversion trading. It enters buy trades when RSI is oversold and price touches the lower Bollinger Band, and sell trades when RSI is overbought and price touches the upper Bollinger Band. The strategy targets price reversals back to the Bollinger Band middle line or uses fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels for exits.
summary_zh: 该EA结合RSI和布林带指标，通过识别超买超卖状态进行均值回归交易。当RSI超卖且价格触及布林带下轨时买入，当RSI超买且价格触及布林带上轨时卖出。策略目标是在价格回归布林带中轨或达到固定止盈止损时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该策略属于典型的均值回归系统，核心概念是利用布林带衡量价格的统计偏离度，同时用RSI确认动量的极端状态。入场条件方面，做多需要价格触及或跌破布林带下轨且RSI处于超卖区域（通常低于30），做空需要价格触及或突破布林带上轨且RSI处于超买区域（通常高于70），双重条件过滤提高了信号质量。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及价格回归布林带中轨时的平仓逻辑。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA依赖布林带的统计特性假设价格会回归均值，但在强趋势市场中可能遭遇连续亏损，缺乏对趋势状态的二次过滤机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在极端行情下的风险敞口控制不足。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is a classic mean reversion system that uses Bollinger Bands to measure statistical price deviation while confirming momentum extremes with RSI. Entry conditions require price to touch or pierce the lower Bollinger Band with RSI in oversold territory (typically below 30) for buy signals, and price to touch or exceed the upper Bollinger Band with RSI in overbought territory (typically above 70) for sell signals, with the dual-condition filter improving signal quality. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as a close-when-price-returns-to-middle-band logic. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional calculations. Money management relies on the statistical assumption that price will revert to the mean within the Bollinger Band envelope, but consecutive losses can accumulate during strong trending markets where the mean reversion assumption fails. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-structured, but risk exposure control during extreme market conditions is insufficient without a secondary trend-state filter.
pros: 双指标确认过滤减少了假信号，提高入场质量
布林带自带统计边界，提供了天然的支撑阻力参考
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调参
均值回归逻辑在震荡行情中表现稳健
参数可调性强，适应不同品种和周期
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation filter reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Bollinger Bands provide natural statistical boundaries serving as support/resistance references
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Mean reversion logic performs robustly in ranging markets
Highly tunable parameters adapt to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在强趋势行情中均值回归假设失效，可能连续亏损
缺乏趋势状态过滤机制，无法区分震荡与趋势市场
固定手数仓位管理未考虑波动率变化，风险敞口不均
布林带参数在低波动率时可能过窄导致频繁假信号
缺少新K线检查，同根K线可能重复开仓
cons_en: Mean reversion assumption fails in strong trending markets, potentially leading to consecutive losses
Lacks a trend-state filter mechanism, cannot distinguish between ranging and trending markets
Fixed lot position sizing ignores volatility changes, leading to uneven risk exposure
Bollinger Bands may be too narrow during low volatility, generating frequent false signals
Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same candle
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期均线），在趋势行情中暂停交易或反转逻辑
引入ATR动态调整止损止盈和仓位大小，使风险敞口与波动率匹配
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher-timeframe MA) to pause trading or reverse logic during trending markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing to match risk exposure with volatility

risk_points: 缺乏趋势状态识别，在单边行情中可能逆势连续开仓导致严重亏损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓放大风险
risk_points_en: Lacks trend-state identification, may consecutively open counter-trend positions during one-sided markets causing severe losses
Missing new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same candle amplifying risk
